decisions.text: behaviour: the light popup ignores a pointer-down on its opener, so the opener's own click toggles it instead of closing and reopening — reverse: drop the opener check in `watchOutside_` (modal-shell.component.ts)
behaviour: the confirm button stays disabled while the held number is 0 — reverse: remove `[disabled]` on the confirm button in stock-ai-draft.component.html

behaviour: the light popup stays a plain card with no close button, closed by an outside tap, a scroll or Escape — reverse: add a close button inside the `app-modal-shell` content in stock-count.component.html

behaviour: the compact checkbox is sized by `::ng-deep` with `!important` in stock-count.component.scss because `list-row-checkbox` is out of scope and a global phone rule in styles.scss forces its size — reverse: size it inside list-row-checkbox.component.scss via a CSS variable
seen: src/app/shared/list-selection/list-row-checkbox.component.scss:1 — `kit-checks` reports KIT_DEBT style-duplicate-class 177 -> 178 for this file, which this branch does not change

behaviour: the counted-mark tap area is now set by min-block-size on the .stock-count__counted cell only. The inline min-size on the checkbox host is gone, so the tap area is slightly narrower — reverse: restore a min size rule on the checkbox host in a shared piece
